haikus.theme: National Cook for Your Pets Day
haikus.haiku:
Soft steam curls a‑round
Paws wag as broth sings in warm
Treats bloom in bowls soft
Happy #NationalCookForYourPetsDay from @ClamBakeSanta

Fresh leaves rustle green
Sunlight drips on tofu soup
Taste buds dance with joy
Happy #WorldVeganDay from @ClamBakeSanta

Soft dusk drifts to night
Leaves whisper cool breaths, clocks sigh
Night sighs, sun still waits
Happy #DaylightSaving

Soft snow falls on ink
Pages glow with quiet light
Crane smiles in soft light
#HappyBirthdayStephen

Soft moonlit petals
Gentle breeze sings lullabies
Joyful hearts glow bright
#HappyBirthdayAishwaryaRai from @ClamBakeSanta

Soft glow curls above
Crickets hum, moonlight dances
Night whispers warm light
Happy #LastQuarterMoon from @ClamBakeSanta
